messages:
lina: Dropping the empty-state mock for the credentials page. Trying 'starter recipes' instead of a single CTA. Screenshot + doc: https://figma.com/file/abc/cred-empty
devin: Love the recipes idea. Quick UX Q: are these templates just pre-filled create forms or distinct workflows?
lina: They're pre-filled flows with a one-click action to open the create modal with fields populated (name, scopes, TTL). Keeps the main CTA but gives context.
sam: For mobile, beware of stacking large cards in the empty state. Maybe collapse into a single accordion on small widths.
kevin: Create-modal detail: include a small lock icon next to TTL if org policy enforces a max. Tooltip: "Policy: max TTL 30d". Also show which field is overridden by policy.
marta: Copy suggestion for recipes: instead of "Create service token", try "Service token — CI/CD" and a subline: "Short-lived token for machines (1h)." Makes intent clearer.
lina: Nice. Also debating CTA wording: "Get started" vs "Create credential". Which reads better for onboarding?
devin: "Create credential" is explicit. Use "Get started" only on marketing pages.
a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: ensure recipe cards are buttons with descriptive aria-labels like "Create service token prefilled: CI/CD, 1 hour TTL". Focus order must flow from page header -> recipes -> main CTA.
sam: Bulk revoke UX thought: after bulk action, show a persistent toast with an undo button and an entry in audit logs. Avoid modal keyword confirmations unless it's destructive for orgs.
kevin: Agree. Also make sure bulk actions indicate scope counts before committing: "You selected 23 tokens across 5 projects."
marta: For revoke language, avoid ambiguous words. Instead of "revoke" use "Disable access" and in the details: "This will reject new requests immediately; existing sessions may continue until token expiry."
devin: Slightly prefer "Disable" as it's clearer for non-security folks. Add inline help linking to docs: "What happens when I disable a token?"
a11y-bot: Color accessibility: do not rely solely on red to indicate disabled. Add an icon and text; test contrast >4.5:1 for body text. Also ensure focus styles are visible for keyboard users (2px outline at least).
lina: Keyboard flow on create: after clicking a recipe, focus should land in the modal name input, then after creation focus moves to the new token's card and the copy button receives focus. We'll prototype that.
sam: Minor perf/visual nit: in compact list view, replace scope icons with short text like "r:read,w:write" to avoid many SVGs. On hover/expand show full chips.
kevin: Rotate flow copy: modal header: "Rotate credential"; body: "Rotating issues a new token and invalidates the old token immediately. Update your services to use the new value." Footer: primary CTA "Rotate and copy new token".
marta: For error states if copy fails, show inline error with retry button and keep token value hidden behind a toggle. Also announce failure with aria-live polite.
a11y-bot: Final accessibility checklist: aria-labels for reveal toggles, aria-live for copy/revoke results, keyboard operable menus, visible focus, color-independent cues.
lina: Thanks everyone — I'll iterate and post the updated mock with the recipe labels and keyboard flows. Will also add the small policy lock + tooltip. Ping me if you want to pair on focus order tests.
